# Cement & Concrete Index

> A living research index spanning cement and binder families, supplementary materials, concrete families and applications, and cross-cutting engineering topics. Daily updates; foundational coverage, not an exhaustive catalogue.

Expanded on 2026-11-08 from the Type IL index. All 139 original records and their caveats remain intact. Four taxonomy axes separate binder chemistry, SCMs/additions, concrete/application families and cross-cutting topics. New sources seed major families; coverage ranges from full technical guides to abstracts, previews and official catalogue scopes. Historical Type IL findings apply to their stated mixtures and exposures, not all cements. Verify current adopted standards and local approvals before use.

Coverage is foundational, not exhaustive. An empty topic is a documented gap, not proof that no literature exists. Unknown publication dates stay blank. Topic membership is the union of `topics` on a resource and `resourceIds` on a topic, so preserved records can belong to a newer topic through `resourceIds` alone.
